entry.title: Alamut Castle

terrainReference.basis: Retained Terrarium grid center relative to decoded working anchor datum.

entry.note: Fresh exact-Q4706020 way 590499418 v3 and all retained component/stair/ruin coordinates match within 0.662 mm. Native +X points southeast at 135.629 degrees and +Z southwest at 225.629 degrees. Northwest cistern/cell ridge, southeast excavation/gate and approach plus Willey north arrow sign the direction. Retained public Terrarium numeric heights form a 16641-value 4 m native grid over a 512 m window. Y0 is decoded 2098.7457 m anchor working datum, not a surveyed regional/ellipsoidal datum. Architectural bodies receive one rigid -25.47 m shift; retained sloping plateau intercept becomes 12.53 m above anchor. This translation is constrained by retained terrain at ruin bases, cut-reservoir floors and interpreted incoming stair route with 0.25 m allowance. It is not an archaeological elevation survey. Local cliff shell and occupied ledge feet extend 4 m below sampled terrain; all five reservoir floors remain above the retained host ground. No whole-precinct terrain cutout/replacement. The host supplies the rest of the mountain. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
